Product.Description: "The PEDR data product contains the along-track, time series collection of MOLA instrument, science mode data in engineering and physical units.  Precision orbit data describing the instrument's position and location has been added to each record.  The precision data is supplied by the MOLA Science Team."

ODE_note: NOTE: Product Type set by ODE
NOTE: Instrument Host Id set by ODE
NOTE: Instrument Id set by ODE
NOTE: Label keyword Orbit number value used for start orbit number value
NOTE: Label keyword Orbit number value used for stop orbit number value
NOTE: Observation time set to mid-point between start time and stop time
NOTE: MOLA PEDR Points loaded into ODE's Mola PEDR Database
Points processed as in PEDR2TAB as described in SOFTWARE/PEDR2TAB/PC/MOLA.LBL
Only ground shots added, no cross over correction applied
